objective: Test whether source coverage and the frozen six-per-window selection cap explain the V2.9 historical E development source sparsity, while keeping the AI-Core semantic definition, development universe, source registry, triage semantics, temporal provenance, and information floor unchanged.

problem_elimination_decision.do_not_repeat: Do not rerun the same 56-window capped experiment.
problem_elimination_decision.single_change_family: Change source coverage and selection censoring only; do not redesign the 18-term discovery registry or classifier in this experiment.
problem_elimination_decision.reason: Coverage/censoring can be measured by exhaustive source census plus deterministic replay of the old design; changing discovery terms simultaneously would confound attribution.

invariants.collector_registry: Frozen V2.8.4 18-term registry; no term additions, removals, stemming, synonym expansion, or result-guided filters.
invariants.temporal_rule: Effective date is the first frozen joint A-share trading date strictly after disclosure date; same-day is forbidden.

source_census.coverage: Every calendar date in the inclusive range exactly once.
source_census.transport_partition: Deterministic contiguous non-overlapping partitions of at most 7 calendar days, used only for transport/retry control and not as a selection gate.
source_census.universe_filter_position: After collector deduplication and frozen triage, before PDF materialization/classification.
source_census.materialize_and_classify: All unique frozen-triage-materializable candidate filings whose canonical_security_id belongs to exactly one admitted development manifest.

H1_TIME_COVERAGE.question: How many eligible AI-Core events occur outside the original frozen 56 source windows?
H1_TIME_COVERAGE.measure: Count and identity of census-positive filings whose disclosure date is outside all original 56 windows.
H1_TIME_COVERAGE.interpretation: Positive count >0 demonstrates recall loss from temporal sampling. It does not by itself prove the information floor would pass.

H3_SELECTION_CENSORING.question: Within the original 56 windows, how many eligible AI-Core events were excluded only by the old deterministic six-per-window / one-security-per-window selection rule?
H3_SELECTION_CENSORING.measure: Replay the original frozen selection algorithm against the census candidate pool for each original window, then compare all classified positives inside those windows with the replay-selected subset.
H3_SELECTION_CENSORING.interpretation: Any positive present inside an original window but absent from the replay-selected subset demonstrates selection censoring. Zero demonstrates no observed positive loss from that cap in the census.

H2_DISCOVERY_NOISE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.question: Which frozen discovery terms generate low-precision candidate traffic?
H2_DISCOVERY_NOISE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.measure: For each frozen term, report deduped candidate count, admitted-universe count, classifier-ready count, positive count, and positive yield. Multi-term filings are counted once globally and may contribute to multiple term diagnostics.
H2_DISCOVERY_NOISE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.interpretation: Descriptive only. No term may be removed, reweighted, expanded, or filtered in this experiment.

old_design_replay.security_diversity: At most one selected filing per canonical_security_id within a window.
old_design_replay.required_replay_check: The replay must exactly reproduce the original 88 selected announcement_ids before H1/H3 attribution is accepted.

required_runner_validation_before_real_c: Verify parent diagnosis exists at the frozen parent commit and status is DIAGNOSIS_COMPLETE_EXPANSION_NOT_AUTHORIZED.
Verify the three admitted development manifests and SHA256/count bindings exactly match this contract and are pairwise disjoint.
Verify collector, triage, classifier and 18-term registry blobs are unchanged from the frozen source-result implementation used by commit 89b7652bb5daad7e9d1ff28ace9a1f0136a746e6.
Construct exactly 730 inclusive calendar dates from 2023-01-01 through 2024-12-30 and exactly 105 non-overlapping transport partitions of at most seven days.
Verify every transport date belongs to exactly one partition and no date outside the frozen range is queried.
Verify no source selection cap or per-security diversity cap exists in the census materialization path.
Verify the old-design replay implementation is isolated from census inclusion and exactly reproduces the original 88 selected announcement_ids on a dry replay fixture before real collection.
Verify temporal provenance uses only the frozen 2023-2024 joint calendar and therefore the disclosure range ends on 2024-12-30 so a strictly later frozen session is always available.
Verify source collection/classification imports no security price, benchmark, return, fold outcome, transaction-cost, strategy-evaluator, live, or brokerage module.
Freeze runner blob SHA and a PASS validation receipt before any real CNINFO query.
forbidden: No mutation or reinterpretation of the frozen V2.9 Historical E Development Source contract or TOO_SPARSE terminal result.
No security price, return, benchmark, transaction-cost, candidate outcome, strategy, live, or brokerage data.
No fold3 or fold4 manifest/source access.
No reopening, mutation, expansion or relabeling of V2.8.12R.
No change to the frozen 18-term registry, frozen triage, frozen AI-Core classifier, positive definition, temporal provenance rule, or information-floor thresholds.
No manual addition, removal, prioritization or replacement of securities or filings based on observed source results.
No positive-yield-driven rerun, date extension beyond 2024-12-30, or post-result change to census inclusion.
No term filtering or discovery redesign based on H2 diagnostics inside this experiment.

Passing this source expansion gate does not authorize outcome research. A separate candidate hypothesis, baseline, cost model, primary metric/horizon and development PASS rule must be preregistered first.
